title: Products & services in Arabic
subtitle: Add an Arabic name and description for each product and service.
explain.title: Where Arabic names are used
explain.used: Messages and pages for customers who read Arabic show the Arabic name and description.
explain.fallback: When no Arabic name exists, customers see the English name instead.
explain.draft: Drafts are not shown to customers. A native Arabic reader must mark the text as reviewed first.
empty: There are no products or services yet.
export.failed: The CSV file could not be downloaded. Please try again.
editor.title: Arabic name and description
editor.name: Name
editor.draftNote: Saving as draft: a native Arabic reader must mark it as reviewed before customers see it.
editor.saveFirst: Save your changes before changing the review status.
review.confirm: Confirm that a native Arabic reader has checked this name and description. Customers who read Arabic will start seeing it.
review.revert: Customers will see the English name again until it is reviewed.
import.title: Import Arabic names from CSV
import.format: Use a CSV file with these columns. Only name_ar is required, plus either kind and id or the exact English name.
import.matchNote: Rows are matched by kind and id, or by the exact English name in the name column.
import.exportHint: Tip: export the CSV first and edit the Arabic columns.
import.dryRunNote: This is a check only. Nothing has been changed yet.
import.appliedNote: The Arabic names were saved as drafts.
import.truncated: Only the first rows are shown.
import.nothingToApply: There is nothing to apply from this file.
import.applyConfirm_one: Save the Arabic text of {count} item as draft?
import.applyConfirm_other: Save the Arabic text of {count} items as drafts?
